abstract: In 1609, the Dutch East India Company (VOC) faced a bear raid by a syndicate of short sellers led by Isaac Le Maire, a former director. We reconstruct the forward trade between 1607 and 1611, the actions taken by the syndicate members, and the responses to these actions by the company. We argue that the bear syndicate members aimed for financial gain from share price declines, while their leader, Le Maire, participated for strategic reasons, that is, breaking up the VOC monopoly. We also show that the government refused to intervene at that time. The raid ended with a squeeze executed by an opposing syndicate, bankrupting several forward traders and blocking Le Maire's plans. We characterize the bear raid and squeeze as a crucial episode in the more general tug‐of‐war between company directors aiming to turn the VOC into an instrument of the state and a diverse group of opposing investors.
title: The first bear raid and squeeze: Isaac Le Maire and the Dutch East India Company
title_zh: 第一次熊市袭击与逼空：艾萨克·勒迈尔与荷兰东印度公司

abstract: China’s rapid surge in urban greening in recent years presents a puzzling deviation from global patterns. We document three stylized facts. Urban greening was stable from 2001 to 2013 but expanded rapidly afterward, coinciding with China’s air pollution control efforts. More polluted cities experienced faster greening growth, and greening disproportionately occurred near air quality monitoring stations. These patterns suggest that urban greening expansion after 2013 in China was largely driven by political pressure arising from air pollution control. The economic benefits of the urban greening expansion exceed the program costs. Our results suggest that top-down air pollution control reshaped local government incentives, improving the provision of environmental public goods and social welfare.

title: Incentivizing environmental public goods: Evidence from urban greening in China
title_zh: 激励环境公共品供给：来自中国城市绿化的证据

abstract: We study two-sided matching with transferable utility in which each match generates a surplus composed of a commonly known observable component and an initially unknown idiosyncratic component. The idiosyncratic component is revealed gradually through a sequence of publicly observed signals, one per worker firm pair per period. The paper examines a benchmark in which signals are produced externally and are observed regardless of the realized matching. This benchmark is motivated by markets with verifiable and portable evaluation such as standardized tests, certifications, platform ratings, and publication records. Under risk neutrality and common posteriors, each date’s market reduces to a standard Shapley-Shubik assignment game on posterior expected surpluses, and stability is defined as membership in the core of that game. We provide closed-form Normal-Normal Bayesian updating, proving existence of core outcomes at every date, and derive comparative statics in signal precision and in the strength of industry specific comparative advantage. The main long run result is that, under a unique efficient matching margin condition, the matching that maximizes posterior expected total surplus coincides with the efficient matching after a finite random time almost surely, and the probability of selecting an inefficient matching at date t admits an explicit exponential upper bound. Simulations illustrate how information accumulation generates early turnover and how industry specific comparative advantage reshapes the decomposition of worker payoff dispersion into within- and between-industry components. This framework gives a clear starting point to study more complex situations where information comes from actual matches or is kept private.
title: Matching with Learning: A Bayesian Assignment Game Approach
title_zh: 匹配与学习：一种贝叶斯指派博弈方法

abstract: How many observations does it take to detect a fixed signal when the noise has long memory? For a sample-mean detector applied to a constant signal buried in fractionally integrated noise of order d ∈ [ 0,1 / 2 ) , I give a closed-form expression for the sample size required to reach a target power at a fixed size: T q ( d ) = [ ( τ + Φ − 1 ( q ) ) σ c d / ( δ x ) ] 2 / ( 1 − 2 d ) . The exponent 2 / ( 1 − 2 d ) is the whole story: the required sample size is a power function of detection difficulty whose exponent diverges as d → 1 / 2 . A doubling of detection difficulty that costs four times the data under independence costs 210 times the data at d = 0.4 . A Monte Carlo confirms the formula delivers the target power and size.
title: The difficulty of telling signal from noise when noise lingers
title_zh: 噪声持续时区分信号与噪声的困难

abstract: Public information campaigns often rely on credible expert messengers to influence people's beliefs. We study how messenger identity and communication technology shape persuasion in a large-scale randomized experiment on vaccination attitudes among young adults in Greece. Participants receive an identical public-health message that varies only in who delivers it---a medical scientist or a social media influencer---and in how it is delivered---through immersive virtual reality or conventional video. Exposure raises trust in vaccines and trust in the healthcare system. Scientists are rated substantially more credible than influencers yet are no more persuasive on average; the two groups' effectiveness rests on different characteristics---the scientists' on perceived reliability and knowledgeability, the influencers' on personal appeal, prior familiarity, and reputation. We find that persuasion is greater under virtual reality, consistent with stronger engagement. Changes in beliefs persist for at least six months, and initially hesitant participants report greater willingness to vaccinate. A model in which engagement, prior uncertainty, and effective credibility enter persuasion multiplicatively rationalizes these patterns.
title: Beyond the Facts: Familiarity, Credibility, and Persuasion
title_zh: 超越事实：熟悉度、可信度与说服力

abstract: Testing for skewness, kurtosis, and normality for time series data is highly relevant for modeling and testing purposes in econometrics and statistics. It also affects our understanding of many economic and financial phenomena and the validity of the models developed to explain them. In this paper, we propose self-normalized tests for skewness, kurtosis, and normality that can eliminate the effect of the long-run variance (LRV). In particular, our tests allow us to avoid using the LRV estimator, which is poorly approximated in finite samples. Consequently, our tests eliminate the need to select the lag-truncation parameter. We provide a high-level condition for the self-normalization function to be valid within our general framework and use the simple normalization proposed in Lobato (2001) and the fixed-b asymptotics initiated in Kiefer et al. (2000) as two leading examples. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate that the self-normalized tests for skewness and normality exhibit good finite-sample properties in terms of size and power. In contrast, the self-normalized test for kurtosis displays substantial size distortions unless the distribution has thin tails, such as the normal distribution. Finally, we apply the tests to eighteen macroeconomic and financial series to study their symmetry, kurtosis, and normality.
title: Self-Normalized Tests for Skewness, Kurtosis, and Normality for Time Series Data
title_zh: 时间序列数据偏度、峰度及正态性的自标准化检验

abstract: A multivariate fractional Brownian motion (mfBm) with component-wise Hurst exponents is used to model and forecast realized volatility (RV). We investigate the interplay between correlation coefficients and Hurst exponents and propose a novel method to estimate model parameters, establishing its consistency and asymptotic normality. Additionally, we develop a time-reversibility test, which is typically not rejected by RV data. When the data generating process is a time-reversible mfBm, we derive optimal forecasting formulae and analyze their properties. A key insight is that an mfBm with different Hurst exponents and non-zero correlations can reduce forecasting errors compared to a one-dimensional model. Consistent with this theory, out-of-sample forecasts using the time-reversible mfBm show improvements over univariate fBm, particularly when the estimated Hurst exponents differ significantly. Empirical results demonstrate that mfBm outperforms HAR and its variants in terms of out-of-sample forecast.
title: Modeling and Forecasting Realized Volatility with Multivariate Fractional Brownian Motion
title_zh: 基于多元分数布朗运动的已实现波动率建模与预测

abstract: We model the interplay of employment relations and community-based interactions among workers and managers. Employment relations can be either tough (where workers are monitored intensively and obtain few rents, and managers do not provide informal favors for workers) or soft (where there is less monitoring, more worker rents, and more workplace favor exchange). Both workers and managers also exert effort in providing community public goods. The threat of losing access to public goods can motivate managers to keep employment soft; conversely, the threat of losing future employment or future workers’ trust can motivate workers and managers to provide effort in the community. Corporate tax cuts; improved worker monitoring; automation, outsourcing, and offshoring; declines in the minimum wage; and opportunities for residential segregation or for privatizing community-provided services can make both workers and managers worse-off by undermining soft employment relations and community cooperation.
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: Employment and Community: Socioeconomic Cooperation and Its Breakdown
title_zh: 就业与社区：社会经济合作及其瓦解

abstract: Using rich cohort data in the United Kingdom, I estimate teacher value-added on students’ test scores and socio-emotional skills in primary school. I find that teachers play a crucial role in both the development of students’ test scores and socio-emotional skills. Conditional on teacher effects on students’ test scores, the impact of teachers on students’ socio-emotional skills persists over time and extends into early adulthood. These teacher effects predict various economic and social outcomes measured at ages 18-20, including university attendance, labour market outcomes, risky health behaviours, pro-social activities, and overall well-being.
title: Teacher Effects on Students’ Socio-Emotional Skills and Young Adult Outcomes
title_zh: 教师对学生社会情感技能及青年期结果的影响

abstract: This paper incorporates the Lucas (1973) island model into a standard DSGE framework. It demonstrates that self-fulfilling stochastic inflation equilibria, which are driven by intrinsic uncertainty or pure sentiments, can exist under rational expectations. Furthermore, it shows that these sentiment-driven stochastic equilibria exhibit monetary non-neutrality, even when the fundamental equilibrium is unique and monetarily neutral. As the aggregate price or inflation rate can appear to fluctuate independently of the money supply, our model explains the complex relationship between inflation and the money supply in the real world, where the basic quantity theory of money often seems invalid.
title: Incomplete Information and Self-fulfilling Inflation Dynamics —Lucas meets Keynes
title_zh: 不完全信息与自我实现的通胀动态——卢卡斯遇见凯恩斯

abstract: Panel or grouped data are often used to allow for unobserved individual heterogeneity in econometric models via fixed effects. In this paper, we discuss identification of a panel data model in which the unobserved heterogeneity both enters additively and interacts with treatment variables. We present identification and estimation methods for parameters of interest in this model under both strict and weak exogeneity assumptions. The key identification insight is that other periods’ treatment variables are instruments for the unobserved fixed effects. We apply our proposed estimator to matched student-teacher data used to estimate value-added models of teacher quality. We show that the common assumption that the return to teacher quality is the same for all students is rejected by the data. We also present evidence that No Child Left Behind-era school accountability raised the effectiveness of teacher quality for lower performing students.
title: Identification of non-additive fixed effects models: Is the return to teacher quality homogeneous?
title_zh: 非加性固定效应模型的识别：教师质量的回报是同质的吗？

abstract: We introduce a new time-varying parameter spatial matrix autoregressive model that integrates matrix-valued time series, heterogeneous spillover effects, outlier robustness, and time-varying parameters in one unified framework. The model allows for separate dynamic spatial spillover effects across both the row and column dimensions of the matrix-valued observations. Robustness can be introduced via a matrix Student’s t distribution. The model can still be estimated straightforwardly by standard maximum likelihood methods, and we establish stationarity and invertibility of the model, as well as consistency and asymptotic normality of its maximum likelihood estimator. Simulations reveal that the two-way spatial spillover dynamics can be successfully recovered even if the model is misspecified. Using a 12 × 12 trade network application, we show that the time-varying, robust matrix features of the new model better fit the empirical data than alternative specifications.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新的时变参数空间矩阵自回归模型，该模型将矩阵值时间序列、异质性溢出效应、异常值稳健性以及时变参数整合在一个统一框架内。该模型允许在矩阵值观测的行和列两个维度上分别存在动态空间溢出效应。通过引入矩阵学生t分布，可以实现稳健性。该模型仍可通过标准最大似然方法简便估计，我们确立了模型的平稳性和可逆性，以及其最大似然估计量的一致性和渐近正态性。模拟结果表明，即使模型设定存在错误，双向空间溢出动态也能被成功恢复。通过一个12×12的贸易网络应用案例，我们展示了新模型的时变、稳健矩阵特征相比其他备选设定能更好地拟合实证数据。
title: Matrix-valued spatial autoregressions with dynamic heterogeneous spillovers
title_zh: 矩阵值空间自回归模型中的动态异质性溢出效应

abstract: Nineteenth-century social reformers promoted the establishment of kindergartens to facilitate the integration of immigrant children in the U.S. society. Exploiting newly collected data on historical kindergarten statistics, we evaluate the impact that the roll-out of the first kindergartens in U.S. cities had on immigrant families. We find that immigrant women exposed to kindergartens experienced a significant reduction in fertility. Their offspring were more likely to attend school, less likely to work during adolescence, and went on to have fewer children as adults. Kindergarten exposure also helped children of non-English-speaking households to acquire English proficiency, thereby illustrating the importance of kindergartens in the social integration of immigrant families. The observed fertility decline, in response to higher returns to education, is consistent with a child quantity–quality tradeoff.
abstract_zh: 十九世纪的社会改革者倡导建立幼儿园，以促进移民儿童融入美国社会。利用新收集的历史幼儿园统计数据，我们评估了美国城市首批幼儿园的推广对移民家庭的影响。研究发现，接触幼儿园的移民女性生育率显著下降。她们的子女更有可能入学，青少年时期工作的可能性较低，并且成年后生育的子女数量更少。幼儿园的接触还帮助了来自非英语家庭的儿童掌握英语能力，从而凸显了幼儿园在移民家庭社会融合中的重要性。观察到的生育率下降，是对教育回报提高的响应，与子女数量与质量权衡相一致。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Froebel’s gifts: how the kindergarten movement changed the immigrant family
title_zh: 福禄贝尔的恩赐：幼儿园运动如何改变了移民家庭

abstract: The consequences of retracting democratic rights in authoritarian regimes remain understudied. In 2018, China’s Communist Party implemented the ‘one-head’ policy, replacing dual village governance with a single leader. Using nationally representative survey data and exploiting the exogeneity of village election cycles as an instrument, we analyze short-term effects on voting behavior and political perceptions. Villages adopting the one-head system experienced a sizable decline in election turnout. At the same time, villagers reported lower perceived corruption and greater confidence in local governance. In addition, we find supporting evidence based on changes in objective economic indicators. These results suggest that recentralization reduced electoral participation but did not erode, and may have improved, (perceived) governance quality in the short run.
abstract_zh: 威权体制下撤回民主权利的后果仍未得到充分研究。2018年，中国共产党实施了“一肩挑”政策，以单一领导取代了村级双重治理。利用全国代表性调查数据，并借助村级选举周期的外生性作为工具变量，我们分析了该政策对投票行为和政治认知的短期影响。实行“一肩挑”制度的村庄，选举投票率显著下降。与此同时，村民报告的腐败感知降低，对地方治理的信心增强。此外，我们基于客观经济指标的变化找到了支持性证据。这些结果表明，权力再集中减少了选举参与，但在短期内并未削弱，甚至可能提升了（感知的）治理质量。

abstract: Abstract Value-added tax (VAT) is the largest source of tax revenue for many developing country governments, and sales-based registration thresholds are a ubiquitous design feature. Yet, empirical evidence on the mechanisms through which these thresholds alter firm behaviour remains scarce. Using administrative tax data from West Bengal in India, we study the behavioural responses of firms to a turnover threshold for compulsory VAT registration. By exploiting variation in the tax discontinuity at the registration threshold across firms and over time, we show that tax incentives, rather than compliance costs, drive the observed bunching of firms below the threshold, and their associated revealed preference for a simplified tax scheme. The limited role for VAT compliance costs relative to a simplified tax regime has important implications for the design of small business taxation and for the optimal level of VAT registration thresholds.
abstract_zh: 增值税（VAT）是许多发展中国家政府最大的税收来源，而基于销售额的注册门槛是一种普遍存在的设计特征。然而，关于这些门槛如何改变企业行为的实证证据仍然稀缺。利用印度西孟加拉邦的行政税收数据，我们研究了企业对强制性增值税注册营业额门槛的行为反应。通过利用注册门槛处税收不连续性在企业间及时间上的变化，我们表明，是税收激励而非合规成本，驱动了观察到的企业聚集于门槛以下的现象，以及它们对简化税制的显性偏好。相较于简化税制，增值税合规成本的作用有限，这对小企业税收设计及增值税注册门槛的最优水平具有重要启示。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Tax incentives, compliance costs, and VAT registration: evidence from India
title_zh: 税收激励、合规成本与增值税登记：来自印度的证据

abstract: Can electoral outcomes shape voters’ perceptions of the past? Election results can provide informational cues that prompt voters to reinterpret prior conditions, shifting the benchmarks on which accountability rests. We examine this through perceptions of crime, a valence issue relevant to any candidate. We compare respondents interviewed just before and after local elections in Chile, across municipalities where a right-wing mayor narrowly won versus lost. Individuals surveyed shortly after a narrow right-wing victory are more likely to report that crime has increased, even though self-reported victimization remains unchanged. Our findings suggest that accountability itself becomes endogenous to electoral results.
abstract_zh: 选举结果能否塑造选民对过去的认知？选举结果可以提供信息线索，促使选民重新解读先前状况，从而改变问责所依赖的基准。我们通过犯罪感知这一与任何候选人都相关的价值议题来考察此问题。我们比较了智利地方选举前后受访者的回答，涵盖右翼市长以微弱优势获胜与落败的市镇。在右翼以微弱优势获胜后不久接受调查的个体，更倾向于报告犯罪率上升，尽管自我报告的受害经历并未改变。我们的发现表明，问责本身对选举结果具有内生性。
title: Electoral results affect beliefs about the past: Evidence from Chile
title_zh: 选举结果影响对过去的认知：来自智利的证据

abstract: A sizable share of marriages in several Asian and African countries are initiated by the man abducting the woman he wishes to wed. In this paper, we use quantitative and qualitative methods to characterize the practice of abduction marriage in Ethiopia. We first present the results from in-depth qualitative interviews with community leaders and abducted women in the Gambella region of Ethiopia to gain a deeper understanding of how the practice functions in these communities. These interviews suggest that abduction is typically used to overcome the refusal of the woman’s family. Second, we use Demographic and Health Survey along with ethnographic data to characterize women and ethnic groups affected by this practice in Ethiopia. Finally, we empirically examine the central hypothesis about the persistence of this practice and find evidence consistent with the hypothesis that men often use abduction to improve bargaining power in marriage negotiations and reduce the size of the bride price payment. Specifically, we demonstrate that droughts—a proxy for income shocks in this setting—increase the probability of abduction marriage only for women from ethnic groups that traditionally exchange a bride price.
abstract_zh: 在多个亚洲和非洲国家，相当比例的婚姻是由男方通过劫持其意中女子来启动的。本文运用定量与定性方法，对埃塞俄比亚的劫婚习俗进行刻画。首先，我们展示了在埃塞俄比亚甘贝拉地区对社区领袖及被劫婚女性的深度定性访谈结果，以深入理解该习俗在这些社区中的运作方式。这些访谈表明，劫婚通常用于克服女方家庭的拒绝。其次，我们利用人口健康调查数据及民族志资料，描绘了埃塞俄比亚受此习俗影响的女性及族群特征。最后，我们实证检验了关于该习俗持续存在的核心假设，并发现证据支持以下假设：男性常利用劫婚来增强婚姻谈判中的议价能力，并减少彩礼支付规模。具体而言，我们证明干旱——在此情境下作为收入冲击的代理变量——仅对传统上交换彩礼的族群中的女性增加了劫婚发生的概率。
title: The economics of abduction marriage: Evidence from Ethiopia
title_zh: 诱拐婚姻的经济学：来自埃塞俄比亚的证据

abstract: Motivated by predicting intraday trading volume curves, we consider two spatio-temporal autoregressive models for matrix time series, in which each column may represent daily trading volume curve of one asset, and each row captures synchronized 5-minute volume intervals across multiple assets. While traditional matrix time series focus mainly on temporal evolution, our approach incorporates both spatial and temporal dynamics, enabling simultaneous analysis of interactions across multiple dimensions. The inherent endogeneity in spatio-temporal autoregressive models renders ordinary least squares estimation inconsistent. To overcome this difficulty while simultaneously estimating two distinct weight matrices with banded structure, we develop an iterated generalized Yule-Walker estimator by adapting a generalized method of moments framework based on Yule-Walker equations. Moreover, unlike conventional models that employ a single bandwidth parameter, the dual-bandwidth specification in our framework requires a new two-step, ratio-based sequential estimation procedure.
abstract_zh: 受日内交易量曲线预测的启发，我们针对矩阵时间序列考虑了两种时空自回归模型，其中每一列可代表某一资产的日交易量曲线，每一行则捕捉多个资产间同步的5分钟交易量区间。传统矩阵时间序列主要关注时间演化，而我们的方法融合了空间与时间动态，能够同时分析多个维度间的交互作用。时空自回归模型中固有的内生性使得普通最小二乘估计不一致。为克服这一难题，同时估计两个具有带状结构的独特权重矩阵，我们通过基于Yule-Walker方程的广义矩方法框架，开发了一种迭代广义Yule-Walker估计量。此外，不同于采用单一带宽参数的传统模型，我们框架中的双带宽设定要求一种新的基于比率的两步顺序估计程序。
title: Spatio-temporal autoregressions for high dimensional matrix-valued time series
title_zh: 高维矩阵值时间序列的时空自回归模型

abstract: This study compares Elastic Net logistic regression with three tree-based ensemble models for one-year-ahead financial distress prediction using 295,416 firm-year observations from Korean SMEs. Financial distress is defined using a forward-looking cash-flow-based criterion requiring both negative operating cash flow relative to total debt and a negative net cash position. Models are developed on 2009–2023 observations using Bayesian optimization and five-fold stratified cross-validation and evaluated on an independent 2024 out-of-time sample. All three tree-based ensemble models achieve stronger threshold-free discrimination than the Elastic Net benchmark. XGBoost achieves the best overall predictive performance, with the highest ROC-AUC (0.8096), PR-AUC (0.5318), and F1-score (0.5445), although its advantage over Random Forest and LightGBM is quantitatively modest. DeLong tests confirm that these ROC-AUC differences are statistically significant despite their small magnitudes. SHAP analysis identifies Debt Dependence, the Interest Coverage Ratio, and operating cash flow relative to sales as the three most influential predictors and reveals nonlinear predictive relationships. Overall, the findings highlight the value of combining a forward-looking distress measure with interpretable nonlinear ensemble models for SME credit risk assessment and early warning. KEYWORDS: Financial distress prediction Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (SMEs) Cash-flow-based financial distress interpretable machine learning SHAP JEL CLASSIFICATION: C53 G33 C55
abstract_zh: 本研究比较了弹性网络逻辑回归与三种基于树的集成模型在韩国中小企业一年期财务困境预测中的表现，使用了295,416个企业-年度观测值。财务困境采用基于前瞻性现金流的标准进行定义，要求同时满足经营现金流相对于总债务为负以及净现金头寸为负两个条件。模型基于2009年至2023年的观测数据，通过贝叶斯优化和五折分层交叉验证进行开发，并在独立的2024年样本外数据上进行了评估。所有三种基于树的集成模型在无阈值判别能力方面均优于弹性网络基准模型。XGBoost取得了整体最佳的预测性能，其ROC-AUC（0.8096）、PR-AUC（0.5318）和F1分数（0.5445）均为最高，尽管其相对于随机森林和LightGBM的优势在数量上较为有限。DeLong检验确认，尽管这些ROC-AUC差异幅度较小，但在统计上具有显著性。SHAP分析识别出债务依赖度、利息覆盖倍数以及经营现金流与销售额之比为三个最具影响力的预测因子，并揭示了非线性预测关系。总体而言，研究结果凸显了将前瞻性困境度量与可解释的非线性集成模型相结合，对中小企业信用风险评估和早期预警的价值。关键词：财务困境预测；中小企业；基于现金流的财务困境；可解释机器学习；SHAP JEL分类：C53 G33 C55
title: Predicting financial distress in Korean SMEs: a comparison of Elastic Net and tree-based ensemble models
title_zh: 预测韩国中小企业财务困境：弹性网络与基于树的集成模型的比较

abstract: Previous studies on inflation expectations suggest that agents often overreact to public signals, motivating extensions of standard macroeconomic models beyond full-information rational expectations and pointing to a role for behavioural explanations. Using Japanese survey data from 2008 to 2024 that include a variety of questions related to behavioural economics, we examine how individuals’ behavioural attributes are associated with responses to public signals. Allowing for a shift in mean forecast errors during Japan’s high-inflation period, we find evidence broadly consistent with overreaction in inflation expectations. However, this overreaction is not fully explained by the behavioural attributes examined in this paper. Our findings suggest that overreaction is not concentrated among individuals classified as behaviourally biased on the basis of the four self-reported attributes in our data: differences in the response to public signals across these attributes are not large enough to make expectations consistent with full-information rational expectations. KEYWORDS: Inflation forecasts over-extrapolation behavioural agents behavioural bias JEL CLASSIFICATION: D84 D91 E31 E70 Acknowledgements We thank M. Eguchi for helpful comments and E. Kurimune for excellent research assistance. The authors used a generative AI tool, ChatGPT (OpenAI, 5.4), to improve English expression. The authors reviewed and revised the output as necessary and take full responsibility for the final manuscript.
abstract_zh: 以往关于通胀预期的研究表明，经济主体往往对公共信号反应过度，这促使标准宏观经济模型在完全信息理性预期之外进行扩展，并指出了行为解释的作用。利用2008年至2024年间包含多种行为经济学相关问题的日本调查数据，我们考察了个体的行为属性如何与对公共信号的反应相关联。在考虑日本高通胀期间平均预测误差的变动后，我们发现了与通胀预期过度反应大致相符的证据。然而，这种过度反应并未被本文所考察的行为属性完全解释。我们的研究结果表明，过度反应并非集中于那些基于我们数据中四项自我报告属性而被归类为具有行为偏差的个体：这些属性之间对公共信号反应的差异不足以使预期与完全信息理性预期保持一致。关键词：通胀预测 过度外推 行为主体 行为偏差 JEL分类：D84 D91 E31 E70 致谢：我们感谢M. Eguchi的有益评论和E. Kurimune出色的研究协助。作者使用生成式AI工具ChatGPT（OpenAI，5.4）来改进英文表达。作者对输出内容进行了必要的审查和修改，并对最终稿件承担全部责任。
title: Overreaction in inflation expectations: do behavioural attributes of individuals matter?
title_zh: 通胀预期中的过度反应：个体行为特征是否重要？

abstract: We examine how social comparison within endogenously formed peer networks affects different measures of young adult mental health. Using over 2 million smartphone-based communication records from the NetHealth Study, we construct objective social networks among university students and estimate a structural model in which individuals choose their peers and mental health depends on the income of chosen peers. When networks are treated as exogenous, higher average peer income predicts better mental health; once network formation is modelled endogenously, the relationship reverses: exposure to higher-income peers significantly worsens depressive symptoms. Income gaps harm mental health in both directions, consistent with inequality aversion rather than relative deprivation. The reversal survives extending binary links to message-weighted networks, and counterfactual exercises show that policies reducing the volume of messages exchanged with peers improve mental health, increasingly so with the size of the reduction, though the effect of targeted reductions depends on which ties are attenuated. Ignoring endogenous peer selection can thus yield qualitatively misleading conclusions about peer effects on mental health.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了内生形成的同伴网络中的社会比较如何影响年轻成人心理健康的多种衡量指标。利用NetHealth研究中超过两百万条基于智能手机的通信记录，我们构建了大学生之间的客观社交网络，并估计了一个结构模型，在该模型中，个体选择其同伴，而心理健康则取决于所选同伴的收入水平。当网络被视为外生时，较高的平均同伴收入预示着更好的心理健康；一旦网络形成被建模为内生过程，这一关系便发生逆转：接触高收入同伴显著加剧了抑郁症状。收入差距在两个方向上都损害心理健康，这与不平等厌恶而非相对剥夺的假设相一致。这一逆转在将二元联系扩展至消息加权网络后依然成立，且反事实实验表明，减少与同伴交换消息量的政策能改善心理健康，且改善程度随减少幅度增大而增强，尽管定向减少的效果取决于被削弱的具体联系。因此，忽视内生的同伴选择可能会对同伴效应影响心理健康得出性质上误导性的结论。
title: Social Comparison and Young Adult Mental Health with Endogenous Network Formation
title_zh: 内生网络形成下的社会比较与青年心理健康研究

abstract: Patent examination speed is critical for firms in rapidly evolving AI technology. Drawing on knowledge recombination perspectives, this study examines how knowledge diversity and technology cycles influence patent examination duration and how firm size moderates these relationships. Using patents in the natural language processing (NLP) sector, we employed Cox proportional hazards models with time-dependent coefficients. The results show that knowledge diversity follows an inverted U-shaped relationship with patent examination duration, with moderate levels of knowledge diversity associated with longer examination durations and higher levels associated with shorter durations. A longer technology cycle is associated with a shorter patent examination duration. Furthermore, firm size strengthens the beneficial effects of knowledge diversity and mature technological knowledge on the efficiency of examinations. This study contributes to the innovation economics literature by highlighting the nonlinear effects of knowledge characteristics and the role of firm heterogeneity in explaining variations in patent examination efficiency. KEYWORDS: Patent examination duration knowledge diversity across firms technology cycle firm size Natural Language Processing JEL CLASSIFICATION: D81 D23 C41
abstract_zh: 专利审查速度对于快速发展的AI技术领域中的企业至关重要。基于知识重组视角，本研究探讨了知识多样性与技术周期如何影响专利审查时长，以及企业规模如何调节这些关系。利用自然语言处理（NLP）领域的专利数据，我们采用了含时变系数的Cox比例风险模型。结果表明，知识多样性与专利审查时长呈倒U型关系，中等程度的知识多样性对应较长的审查时长，而较高程度的知识多样性则对应较短的审查时长。较长的技术周期与较短的专利审查时长相关联。此外，企业规模增强了知识多样性和成熟技术知识对审查效率的积极影响。本研究通过强调知识特征的非线性效应以及企业异质性在解释专利审查效率差异中的作用，为创新经济学文献做出了贡献。关键词：专利审查时长 跨企业知识多样性 技术周期 企业规模 自然语言处理 JEL分类：D81 D23 C41
title: Knowledge bases and patent examination efficiency in Artificial Intelligence: the roles of knowledge diversity, technology cycle, and firm heterogeneity
title_zh: 人工智能中的知识库与专利审查效率：知识多样性、技术周期与企业异质性的作用

abstract: We study labor supply and savings responses to an increase in the full pension eligibility age in the context of South Korea. Using a regression discontinuity design, we document the causal effects of the change on several potential margins of adjustment. We find clear evidence of delayed benefit claiming, consistent with studies in other settings. However, we find little to no statistical evidence of changes in labor supply, in contrast with previous literature. We also find no significant changes in savings or spending. These muted responses may be, in part, because the South Korean pension is relatively new and benefit replacement rates are comparatively modest.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了韩国提高全额养老金领取资格年龄对劳动供给和储蓄行为的影响。利用断点回归设计，我们记录了该政策变化在多个潜在调整维度上的因果效应。我们发现明确的证据表明，人们延迟了福利申领，这与在其他情境下的研究结果一致。然而，与先前文献相比，我们几乎没有发现劳动供给变化的统计证据。同时，储蓄或支出方面也未出现显著变化。这些温和的反应可能部分归因于韩国养老金制度相对较新，且福利替代率相对较低。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Labor supply and savings responses to increasing the full pension eligibility age in South Korea
title_zh: 韩国提高全额养老金领取年龄对劳动供给与储蓄的影响

abstract: This study investigates the proficiency of three leading GPTs, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, and Gemini, in answering final-exam questions for an undergraduate course in Financial Markets and Intermediaries, a specialized finance education context characterized by heterogeneous cognitive and assessment demands. Drawing on Bloom’s revised taxonomy and Cognitive Load Theory (CLT), this study examines whether GPT performance varies across assessment formats requiring different levels of cognitive processing and reasoning. The results revealed significant divergences: Gemini achieved the highest scores, demonstrating strong comprehension and reasoning skills, whereas ChatGPT showed moderate proficiency and DeepSeek underperformed. All models performed better on multiple-choice questions than on open-ended questions, suggesting that GPTs currently perform more effectively in tasks associated with lower-order cognitive processes. Computational questions posed the greatest challenges across all models, supporting theoretical expectations from CLT. The findings contribute to literature on generative AI in higher education showing that GPT proficiency is not uniform across cognitive assessment levels and by proposing a framework linking AI performance to educational assessment theories. Highly proficient GPTs can serve as valuable supplementary tools for students and educators; however, limitations in complex reasoning, computational accuracy, and regulatory interpretation require critical use. Findings should be interpreted with caution given the single-course single-institution setting.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了三种主流GPT模型——ChatGPT、DeepSeek与Gemini——在回答金融学本科课程《金融市场与中介》期末考试题目时的表现水平。该课程属于专业金融教育情境，其特点在于评估要求具有异质性的认知层次与考核类型。基于布鲁姆修订分类学与认知负荷理论（CLT），本研究考察了GPT在不同认知加工与推理要求下的评估形式中是否表现出性能差异。结果显示存在显著分化：Gemini得分最高，展现出较强的理解与推理能力；ChatGPT表现中等；DeepSeek则相对逊色。所有模型在选择题上的表现均优于开放式题目，表明当前GPT在涉及低阶认知过程的任务中表现更为有效。计算类题目对所有模型构成最大挑战，这与认知负荷理论的理论预期相符。本研究为高等教育中生成式人工智能的相关文献作出贡献，揭示了GPT能力在不同认知评估层次上并非均匀分布，并提出一个将人工智能表现与教育评估理论相联系的框架。高水平的GPT可作为学生与教师的有益辅助工具；然而，其在复杂推理、计算准确性及监管解释方面的局限性要求批判性使用。鉴于本研究基于单一课程、单一院校的设定，对研究结果的解读应保持审慎。

title: AI in the classroom: assessing GPTs’ capability in undergraduate finance tests

abstract: This paper derives the exact minimum number of impact sign restrictions required to identify shocks in a structural vector autoregression under a natural pairwise separation condition. The answer is . The proof follows from deriving a sharp lower bound using a Kraft-type inequality and then constructing an admissible restriction matrix that attains the bound. Our result reveals a significant sparsity gain: while traditional recursive orderings require restrictions, sign-based separation requires only , providing a transparent benchmark for designing sparse identifying schemes in large SVARs.
abstract_zh: 本文推导了在自然成对分离条件下，结构向量自回归中识别冲击所需的最小精确影响符号约束数量。答案是 。证明过程通过利用Kraft型不等式推导出尖锐下界，随后构造一个达到该下界的可行约束矩阵来完成。我们的结果揭示了显著的稀疏性优势：传统递归排序需要 个约束，而基于符号的分离仅需 个，为大型SVAR中设计稀疏识别方案提供了透明的基准。
title: How many sign restrictions are needed? A sharp lower bound for identifying multiple shocks in SVARs

abstract: This study investigates the impact of government accounting supervision on the adoption of supply chain finance (SCF) among Chinese listed firms. Using a difference‐in‐differences (DID) approach and a comprehensive dataset spanning 1999 to 2022, we find robust evidence that government accounting supervision significantly promotes the adoption of SCF. This relationship remains resilient across a battery of robustness checks, including parallel trend analysis, propensity score matching (PSM‐DID), placebo tests, and alternative sample specifications. Mechanism analysis reveals that the positive impact of government accounting supervision is primarily driven by enhanced supply chain transparency and the suppression of abnormal related‐party transactions. Furthermore, cross‐sectional analyses reveal that this effect is more pronounced in firms with higher supplier concentration or those lacking political connections. Overall, our findings offer important insights into the role of institutional oversight in fostering financial innovation and enhancing supply chain sustainability.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了政府会计监督对中国上市公司采纳供应链金融（SCF）的影响。采用双重差分法（DID）及覆盖1999年至2022年的综合数据集，我们发现了强有力的证据表明，政府会计监督显著促进了供应链金融的采纳。这一关系在多项稳健性检验中依然稳固，包括平行趋势分析、倾向得分匹配（PSM-DID）、安慰剂检验及替代样本设定。机制分析揭示，政府会计监督的积极影响主要源于供应链透明度的提升及对异常关联方交易的抑制。此外，横截面分析显示，在供应商集中度较高或缺乏政治关联的企业中，这一效应更为显著。总体而言，我们的研究为制度监督在促进金融创新及增强供应链可持续性方面的作用提供了重要见解。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象明确为中国上市公司，数据覆盖1999-2022年，核心应用场景为中国供应链金融，属于直接相关研究。
title: The Watchful Eye: Government Accounting Supervision and Its Effects on Supply Chain Finance
title_zh: 警惕之眼：政府会计监督及其对供应链金融的影响

abstract: This paper investigates how informal political patronage subverts environmental regulation and local economic performance in China. We demonstrate that patronage provides local officials with political insurance, enabling them to safely shield polluting firms from top-down enforcement. Contrary to the promotion tournament hypothesis, this forbearance does not drive GDP growth. Instead, it is sustained through localized rent extraction. Utilizing firm-level data and shocks induced by provincial party secretary turnover, we find that connected officials extract a political tax, measured via perk expenditures, from both polluting and non-polluting enterprises. This systemic extortion generates broad negative spillovers: while shielding incumbent polluters, patronage crowds out productive investment and deters clean market entrants, ultimately degrading both environmental outcomes and the regional business environment.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了非正式政治庇护如何在中国颠覆环境规制及地方经济表现。我们证明，庇护为地方官员提供了政治保险，使其能够安全地庇护污染企业免受自上而下的执法。与晋升锦标赛假说相反，这种纵容并未推动GDP增长。相反，它通过地方化的租金抽取得以维持。利用企业层面数据及省委书记更替引发的冲击，我们发现，关联官员通过额外津贴支出衡量的政治税收，从污染与非污染企业中抽取。这种系统性勒索产生了广泛的负面溢出效应：在庇护现有污染者的同时，庇护行为挤出了生产性投资，阻碍了清洁市场进入者，最终同时恶化了环境成果与区域商业环境。

title: Political Patronage, Rent-Extraction, and Social Costs: Evidence from China’s Environmental Cleanup

abstract: The year 2025 was unprecedented in the frequency, complexity, and volatility of US trade policy interventions. This column uses a new database tracking US tariff announcements during the year to show that confusion about the current state of tariff policy led to a decline in US imports that was similar in size to the reduction caused by tariff increases alone, meaning that confusion doubled the negative impact of tariffs. Product customisation, relationship trust, and partner reputation can help firms maintain trade activity during information shocks.
abstract_zh: 2025年，美国贸易政策干预的频率、复杂性和波动性达到了前所未有的程度。本文利用一个追踪该年度美国关税公告的新数据库，表明对关税政策现状的困惑导致美国进口下降，其幅度与仅因关税上调造成的减少量相当，这意味着困惑使关税的负面影响翻倍。产品定制化、关系信任及合作伙伴声誉有助于企业在信息冲击期间维持贸易活动。
authors: Kalina Manova, Dennis Novy, Thomas Sampson, Aaron Tang
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为美国关税政策及其对进口的影响，数据与制度背景均非中国，核心应用不涉及中国。
title: Tariff confusion
title_zh: 关税迷局

abstract: US net migration turned negative in 2025 following a sharp tightening of immigration policies. This column turns to the Age of Mass Migration and the sharp policy reversal of the 1921 and 1924 Quota Acts to examine how immigration shapes long-run growth through its contribution to innovation. The authors find that without the Age of Mass Migration, US GDP per capita would have been 8.2% lower by 1940, while the policy that ended mass migration harmed the US comparatively little. They also demonstrate the importance of geography: the impact of immigration on productivity depends not only on how many arrive and how skilled they are, but also where they settle.
abstract_zh: 2025年，随着移民政策的急剧收紧，美国净移民转为负值。本文回顾大规模移民时代及1921年和1924年《配额法案》引发的政策急转，探讨移民如何通过其对创新的贡献塑造长期增长。作者发现，若无大规模移民时代，到1940年美国人均GDP将低8.2%，而终结大规模移民的政策对美国造成的损害相对较小。他们还证明了地理因素的重要性：移民对生产率的影响不仅取决于抵达人数及其技能水平，还取决于他们的定居地点。
authors: Costas Arkolakis, Sun Kyoung Lee, Michael Peters
title: Immigration, innovation, and the geography of growth: Lessons from the Age of Mass Migration
title_zh: 移民、创新与增长的地理分布：大规模移民时代的启示

abstract: We develop a theoretical model that explains these findings, and estimate it to quantify the importance of salient unfair prices. We find that a 20 percentage-point salient difference between local and international prices is equivalent to a 1% increase in the price of the local product itself. Next, we use the model and its estimated parameters to calculate the impact of the regulation on consumer utility. We find that utility declined for some products included in the regulation. This happens when the disutility from observing that other consumers pay less exceeds the added utility from reduced prices and increased consumption. We discuss potential implications of our findings for optimal pricing strategies, price rigidity, and theoretical models of salient thinking.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个理论模型来解释这些发现，并对其进行估计以量化显著不公平价格的重要性。我们发现，本地价格与国际价格之间20个百分点的显著差异，相当于本地产品本身价格上涨1%。接着，我们利用该模型及其估计参数来计算监管对消费者效用的影响。结果显示，监管涵盖的部分产品效用有所下降。这种情况发生在观察到其他消费者支付更低价格所带来的负效用，超过了因价格降低和消费增加而获得的额外效用时。我们讨论了我们的发现对最优定价策略、价格刚性以及显著性思维理论模型的潜在启示。
title: Price Saliency and Fairness: Evidence from Regulatory Shaming
title_zh: 价格显著性公平性：来自监管羞辱的证据

abstract: We match firm-corporate governance characteristics with firm-level carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions over the period 2009-2019 to study the relationship between gender diversity in the workplace and firm carbon emissions. We find that a 1 percentage point increase in the percentage of female managers within the firm leads to a 0.5% decrease in CO2 emissions. We document that this effect is statically significant, also when controlling for institutional differences caused by more patriarchal and hierarchical cultures and religions. At the same time, we show that gender diversity at the managerial level has stronger mitigating effects on climate change if females are also well-represented outside the organization, e.g. in political institutions and civil society organizations. Finally, we find that, after the Paris Agreement, firms with greater gender diversity reduced their CO2 emissions by about 5% more than firms with more male managers.
title: Does gender diversity in the workplace mitigate climate change?
title_zh: 职场性别多样性能否缓解气候变化？

abstract: We review the recent literature on the determinants and effects of housing market expectations. We begin by providing an overview of existing surveys that elicit housing market expectations, and discuss how those surveys may be expanded in the future. We then document a number of facts about time-series and cross-sectional patterns of housing market expectations in these survey data, before summarizing research that has studied how individuals form these expectations. Housing market expectations are strongly influenced by recently observed house price changes, by personally or locally observed house price changes, by house price changes observed in a person's social network, and by current home ownership status. Similarly, experienced house price volatility affects expectations uncertainty. We also summarize recent work that documents how differences in housing market expectations translate into differences in individuals’ housing market behaviors, including their home purchasing and mortgage financing decisions. Finally, we highlight research on how expectations affect aggregate outcomes in the housing market.
title: Housing Market Expectations
title_zh: 住房市场预期

abstract: We investigate a method for eliciting relative poverty rankings that aggregates partial poverty rankings obtained from multiple individuals. We first demonstrate that the method works in principle, then apply it in urban Cˆote d’Ivoire. We find that constructed rankings are often incomplete, not always transitive and sometimes contain cycles. Pairwise rankings reported by respondents and constructed aggregate rankings are poorly correlated with measures of poverty obtained from survey data. Measuring relative poverty through peer rankings appears difficult in urban and periurban settings.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一种汇总多位个体提供的部分贫困排名，以得出相对贫困排名的方法。我们首先证明该方法在原理上可行，随后将其应用于科特迪瓦城市地区。我们发现，构建出的排名往往不完整，并非总是具有传递性，有时甚至包含循环。受访者报告的两两排名与构建的汇总排名，与通过调查数据获得的贫困度量指标相关性较弱。在城市及城郊环境中，通过同伴排名来衡量相对贫困似乎颇具难度。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为科特迪瓦城市地区，数据与制度背景均非中国，与中国研究无直接关联。
title: Measuring Relative Poverty through Peer Rankings: Evidence from Côte d’Ivoire
title_zh: 通过同伴排名衡量相对贫困：来自科特迪瓦的证据

abstract: this paper we propose two simple methods to estimate models of matching with transferable and separable utility introduced in Galichon and Salanie (2022). The first method is a minimum distance estimator that relies on the generalized entropy of matching. The second relies on a reformulation of the more special but popular Choo and Siow (2006) model; it uses generalized linear models (GLMs) with two-way fixed effects.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了两种简便方法来估计Galichon和Salanie（2022）引入的可转移且可分离效用的匹配模型。第一种方法是一种最小距离估计器，依赖于匹配的广义熵。第二种方法基于对更为特殊但广受欢迎的Choo和Siow（2006）模型的重新表述；它利用具有双向固定效应的广义线性模型（GLMs）。
title: Estimating Separable Matching Models
title_zh: 估计可分离匹配模型
